questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of a mother and a son is 4 : 1 Fourteen years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 2 : 1. The present age (in years) of the mother is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of the present age, Mother : Son = 4 : 1

**Calculation:**

Let the present ages of mother and son be 4x and x respectively

According to the question

(4x + 14) / (x + 14) = 2/1

⇒ (4x + 14) = 2 (x + 14)

⇒ 4x + 14 = 2x + 28

⇒ 4x – 2x = 28 – 14

⇒ 2x = 14

⇒ x = 14/2

⇒ x = 7

∴ Present age of mother = 4 × 7 = 28 years

questions.question: A, B and C can do a work in 12, 15 and 20 days respectively. In how many days, working together they can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A, B and C can do a work in 12, 15, and 20 days respectively

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

Total work = 60 units (LCM of 12, 15, 20)

⇒ Efficiency of A = 60/12 = 5 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 60/15 = 4 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of C = 60/20 = 3 units/day

∴ A, B and C together complete the whole work in = 60/(5 + 4 + 3) = 60/12 = 5 days.

questions.question: The average marks of 30 students is 65; that of 36 students is 35 and that of 34 students is 45. The average marks for all the students is:
questions.solution:
**Given: **Average marks: 30 students = 65, 36 students = 35, 34 students = 45

Formula Used:

Average = Total marks/Number of students

**Calculation:**

Sum of marks of 30 students = 30 × 65 = 1950

Sum of marks of 36 students = 36 × 35 = 1260

Sum of marks of 34 students = 34 × 45 = 1530

∴ Average of 100 students = (1950 + 1260 + 1530)/100 = 4740/100 = 47.40

questions.question: A bus covers a distance of 10 km in 12 minutes. If its speed is decreased by 25 km/h then the time (in minutes) take by the bus to cover the same distance is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to cover 10 km = 12 min

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time taken

**Calculation:**

Distance covered by bus 10 km in 12 min.

As we know,

Speed = Distance/Time

Speed of bus = 10/(12/60) = 50 km/hr

⇒ New speed of bus = 50 – 25 = 25 km/hr

∴ Time to cover 10 km distance with speed of 25 km/hr = 10/25 × 60 = 24 min

questions.question: The average number of pages of nine books is 400. If the average number of pages of the first five books is 430 and that of the last five books is 380, then what is the number of pages of the fifth book?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average number of pages: 9 books = 400, first 5 books = 430, last 5 books = 380

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of number of pages/Number of books

**Calculation:**

Sum of pages of 9 books = 9 × 400 = 3600

Sum of pages of first 5 books = 5 × 430 = 2150

Sum of pages of last 5 books = 5 × 380 = 1900

∴ Pages of the fifth book = 2150 + 1900 – 3600 = 450

questions.question: A man travels 75 km at speed 25 km/h and next 60 km at 20 km/h and thereafter travel 90 km at 15 km/h. His average speed is;
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time to cover: 75 km at 25 kmph, 60 km at 20 kmph, 90 km at 15 kmph

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = Total distance covered/Total time taken

**Calculation:**

As we know,

Average speed = Total distance/total time

Time to cover 75 km distance with the speed of 25 km/hr = 75/25 = 3 hr

Time to cover 60 km distance with the speed of 20 km/hr = 60/20 = 3 hr

Time to cover 90 km distance with the speed of 15 km/hr = 90/15 = 6 hr

⇒ Total distance = 75 + 60 + 90 = 225 km

⇒ Total time = 3 + 3 + 6 = 12 hr

∴ Average speed = 225/12 = 18.75 km/hr
